Suppose the functor <MATH_0001> is defined on all locally ringed spaces,
and if conditions of Lemma <REF_0001> are replaced by
the following:
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> <MATH_0002> satisfies the sheaf property on the category of locally ringed
spaces,
<STRUCT_0003> there exists a set <MATH_0003> and a collection of subfunctors
<MATH_0004> such that
<STRUCT_0004>
<STRUCT_0005> each <MATH_0005> is representable by a scheme,
<STRUCT_0006> each <MATH_0006> is representable by open immersions
on the category of locally ringed spaces, and
<STRUCT_0007> the collection <MATH_0007> covers <MATH_0008>
as a functor on the category of locally ringed spaces.
<STRUCT_0008>
<STRUCT_0009>
We leave it to the reader to spell this out further.
Then the end result is that the functor <MATH_0009> is
representable in the category of locally ringed spaces
and that the representing object is a scheme.
